Bring every client with you See how importing works Product Pricing Integrations Customers Company About Blog Contact Overview Buy Brightlight Help center Getting started Invoices and quotes Getting paid Reminders Tax and reports Plans and billing Basics Updated September 2026 Getting started Set up your business details, add a client and send your first invoice in a few minutes. Add your business details Open Settings > Business and fill in your name, address and tax number. These appear on every invoice, so it is worth getting them right before the first one goes out. Add your logo and pick a colour while you are there. Add a client Go to Clients and add the name, email and billing address of someone you work for.
